description:
A straight-to-VHS OVA series for the mixed media project Tama & Friends.

Note: The 1993 TV series '3 Choume no Tama: Uchi no Tama Shirimasenka?' is a recut of 6 of these OVA episodes, omitting the first episode but adding 3 additional new episodes. The first episode would remain out-of-print until 2013 when it was digitally remastered for the series 30th anniversary.
